investigations.decision: remain partial; first B6 checkout pass bounded

investigations.exactGap: Current binding anonymous energy/start/time/blocking values are still rendered in the station-selected checkout rather than an accessible authoritative all-estate tariff matrix.

investigations.resumeCondition: Current station-selected Mer/web/app payload for the complete first-party location set, or first-party deterministic anonymous rule.

backendFamilyProgress.B6: Espelkamp parked; Nienburg and Rotenburg advanced to concrete checkout-payload gaps without mixing registered tariffs.

nextSafeAction: Continue B6 with a candidate where the first-party page publishes the anonymous numeric tariff directly; avoid opaque checkout-only operators unless a concrete station token/payload is available.
